answer: WITH latest AS (SELECT pr.snapkey, pr.sitetie, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.sitetie ORDER BY pr.snapts DESC) AS rn FROM plant_record pr), v AS (SELECT p.sitelabel, (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric AS pn, (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric AS pl FROM latest l JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = l.sitetie JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = l.snapkey WHERE l.rn = 1) SELECT sitelabel, ROUND(pn * (1 - pl / (pn + pl)), 2) AS effective_power_output FROM v WHERE pn IS NOT NULL AND pl IS NOT NULL AND (pn + pl) <> 0 ORDER BY effective_power_output DESC

SELECT LOWER(pm.pnlkind) AS panel_kind, AVG(((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v')::numeric) / (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric) AS avg_voltage_degradation_factor FROM electrical_performance e JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = e.snaplink JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook WHERE (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v') IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v') IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric > 0 GROUP BY LOWER(pm.pnlkind) ORDER BY avg_voltage_degradation_factor DESC

SELECT SUM(((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'cumulative_deg_pct')::numeric / ((pr.snapts::date - p.goliveon) / 365.25)) / 100 * 400000 * 50 * 15) AS total_lifetime_revenue_loss FROM plants p JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = pr.snapkey WHERE pm.degyrrate * 20 > 14 AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'cumulative_deg_pct') IS NOT NULL AND pr.snapts::date > p.goliveon

SELECT AVG(o.maintcost / ((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.snapts - p.goliveon::timestamp)) / 3600) / o.mtbfh)) AS avg_mean_repair_cost FROM operational_metrics o JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = o.snapops JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie WHERE o.mtbfh > 0 AND o.mtbfh <> 'NaN' AND o.mttrh IS NOT NULL AND o.mttrh <> 'NaN' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.snapts - p.goliveon::timestamp)) > 0 AND o.mttrh / (o.mtbfh + o.mttrh) > 0.05
note: No snapshot has MTTR/(MTBF+MTTR) > 0.05 (max ~0.04), so result is NULL.

answer: SELECT sitelabel, warrclaims FROM plants WHERE LOWER(warrstate) = 'claimed' AND warrclaims > 2 ORDER BY warrclaims DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.sitetie) AS plant_count FROM mechanical_condition m JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = m.snapmk WHERE LOWER(m.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'grounding_status') = 'failed' OR LOWER(m.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'bypass_diode_status') <> 'normal'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.maintcost / (17520 / o.mtbfh))::numeric) AS mean_repair_cost FROM operational_metrics o JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = o.snapops JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook WHERE LOWER(pm.pnlkind) = 'hjt' AND o.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh > 0 AND o.mtbfh <> 'NaN'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS snapshot_count FROM electrical_performance WHERE (elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::numeric > 15
note: soil_loss_pct maxes at 14.99, so no snapshot exceeds 15% (30/200); result is 0.

answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.sitetie) AS plant_count FROM electrical_performance e JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = e.snaplink JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = e.snaplink WHERE (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio') IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND o.mttrh IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh <> 'NaN' AND o.mttrh <> 'NaN' AND (o.mtbfh + o.mttrh) > 0 AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio')::numeric < 0.75 AND (1 - o.mttrh / (o.mtbfh + o.mttrh)) < 0.95
note: No snapshot has availability below 95% (either MTTR/MTBF-based or availability_pct), so result is 0.

answer: SELECT (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric / ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric + (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric)) AS effective_power_w FROM electrical_performance e WHERE LOWER(e.snaplink) = 'pv945724'
